## Human peer review before merge

This PR must be opened and merged by a human. AI tools may help draft its content and assist review; they must not open or merge it.

Code changes require review and approval by at least one other human team member, besides the author of the changes. Record the review on this PR. AI tools may assist the human reviewer, but the reviewer must assess the changes and decide whether to approve; self-review or AI review alone does not satisfy this requirement. After approval, resolution of review blockers and passing required checks, either the human task/PR author or the human reviewer may merge, subject to repository permissions and protections.

- [ ] For code changes, another human team member has reviewed and approved the changes being merged, including substantive updates after an earlier review.
- [ ] Review blockers are resolved and required checks pass.
